name: Proparacaine
summary: Proxymetacaine (INN) or proparacaine (USAN) is a topical anesthetic drug of the aminoester group.

pharmacology.text: Proxymetacaine is believed to act as an antagonist on voltage-gated sodium channels to affect the permeability of neuronal membranes; how this inhibits pain sensations and the exact mechanism of action of proxymetacaine are, however, unknown.

uses.text: Proxymetacaine (INN) or proparacaine (USAN) is a topical anesthetic drug of the aminoester group.

summaryZh: 丙美卡因是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C16H26N2O3，可用作表面麻醉藥。
summaryZhHans: 丙美卡因是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C16H26N2O3，可用作表面麻醉药。

sideEffects.en: It can cause brief stinging and redness. Repeated or long-term use can seriously damage the surface of the eye, and allergic reactions are rare.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起短暫刺痛和發紅。反覆或長期使用可能嚴重傷害眼睛表面，過敏反應則很少見。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起短暂刺痛和发红。反复或长期使用可能严重伤害眼睛表面，过敏反应则很少见。

fact.en: Proxymetacaine drops tend to sting less than many other numbing eye drops, which is one reason eye doctors often use them before measuring eye pressure.
fact.zh: 丙美卡因眼藥水的刺痛感通常比許多其他麻醉眼藥水輕，這也是眼科醫師常在測量眼壓前使用它的原因之一。
fact.zhHans: 丙美卡因眼药水的刺痛感通常比许多其他麻醉眼药水轻，这也是眼科医师常在测量眼压前使用它的原因之一。
